title: Abandoned Pawn, Unrivaled Dragon King
description: A fantasy-action vertical series about a once-discarded underdog who turns out to be hiding the power of an unrivaled dragon king.
descriptionMore: Written off and cast aside by the people closest to him, the lead's true strength stays hidden until circumstances force his hand — triggering a fast-paced run of power reveals, confrontations, and reversals typical of the genre's underdog-to-overlord arc, told across 43 vertical episodes.
